settings.heading: Q1：Your recent Venustas heated apparel.
settings.body: A:  I recently got the Venustas Heated Jacket with Battery Pack 7.4V (Unisex), 6 heat zones, Heated Coat for Women and Men with Detachable Hood!

settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: A:  On cold days at the barn I am miserably cold!!! This makes my body super tense which in return makes my horses tense in their work. Now having the heated jacket, my muscles are warmed up and ready to work the horses I help train properly.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: A: The most appealing part about the Venustas is the light weight look of such an established piece! It fits perfectly and doesn’t look bulky! I also love how it has 3 temperatures! It is perfect for those long days at the barn where you have the super cold mornings to the warmer afternoons.

settings.heading: Q4: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: A:  I absolutely love Venustas heated apparel! It is totally life changing! I am naturally cold, but having this apparel makes me comfortable in even the coldest situations!

settings.heading: Q5: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body:
A: I think I should be Venustas V+ Master because I bring awareness of the brand to my fellow Equestrians! Many of us have to be in the cold 24/7 with our ponies. This is a year round sport and no one should go without this life changing item! It is a total game changer!
I am actively on Instagram. I have my own equestrian account highlighting what all I do in a day and what products keep me and my horses going! Venustas has been added to that list and I will continue to share and post about this brand!
